index_path.description: Path to notmuch index database; corresponds to `-p`/`--mailindex-path` option

notmuch_config.description: Path to notmuch configuration file; corresponds to `-n`/`--notmuch-config` option

logfile.description: Path to log file; `/dev/null` disables logging; corresponds to `-l`/`--logfile` option

loglevel.description: Log verbosity: one of debug, info, warning, error; corresponds to `-d`/`--debug-level` option

colourmode.description: Terminal colour depth: one of 1, 16, 256; corresponds to `-C`/`--colour-mode` option

read_only.description: Open notmuch database in read-only mode; corresponds to `-r`/`--read-only` option
